_comment: Deterministic demo dataset served by tools/capture/mocks/ado.mjs. Stands in for a real Azure DevOps org so the capture harness is hermetic (no PAT, no network, stable across runs). Shapes follow the ADO REST 7.1 responses the extension consumes.
